governed.config: Scalafix reads the project's .scalafix.conf; without one JGates runs its DisableSyntax rule (no var, null, return, while, throw, asInstanceOf or isInstanceOf), because Scalafix cannot run without a rule

suppressions.description: honored: // scalafix:ok and // scalafix:off ... // scalafix:on comments, and @SuppressWarnings("scalafix:...")

en.label: Scalafix (Scala)
en.purpose: Scala's linting and rewriting tool, run in check mode: it reports what its rules would change or forbid, such as vars, nulls, returns and loops.
en.limitation: Without a project .scalafix.conf it runs only the syntactic DisableSyntax rule; rules that need compiled semantic information (RemoveUnused, ExplicitResultTypes) need the project's build and are not run.
en.needs: The Java runtime of the tools image and about 1 GB of memory; no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: Scalafix (Scala)
pt-BR.purpose: A ferramenta de lint e reescrita de Scala, em modo de verificação: relata o que suas regras mudariam ou proibiriam, como vars, nulls, returns e laços.
pt-BR.limitation: Sem um .scalafix.conf no projeto, roda só a regra sintática DisableSyntax; regras que precisam de informação semântica compilada (RemoveUnused, ExplicitResultTypes) exigem o build do projeto e não são executadas.
pt-BR.needs: O ambiente Java da imagem de ferramentas e cerca de 1 GB de memória; sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
